title: Multi-Algorithm Approach to Snake Game: A Comprehensive Study of Minimax, Reinforcement Learning, and Heuristic Search Methods

contributions.purpose: 首次系统对比多种算法范式在贪吃蛇环境的表现
contributions.mechanism: 统一环境下实现 minimax(alpha-beta 剪枝的单人游戏适配)、DQN/A3C/PPO、A*/贪心/哈密顿回路共 7 种算法并交叉对比
contributions.evaluation: PPO 平均分最高 847.3,minimax 623.7,A* 445.3,贪心 267.8(20x20 网格,每算法 1000 次运行)
contributions.domain: 游戏 AI / 算法对比研究
contributions.source_quote: We present the first comprehensive comparative study of multiple algorithmic approaches to the Snake game, including novel adaptations of minimax for single-player environments.

contributions.purpose: 提供标准化的游戏算法评测框架
contributions.mechanism: 定义平均分/存活时长/收集效率/一致性/计算复杂度/可扩展性六类指标,3 种网格尺寸各 1000 次独立运行,Wilcoxon 符号秩检验
contributions.evaluation: 所有算法两两差异显著(p<0.001),Cohen's d 0.8-2.4
contributions.source_quote: We develop a unified evaluation framework with standardized metrics and statistical analysis methods.

contributions.purpose: 揭示性能-一致性-算力三方权衡并给出算法选型建议
contributions.mechanism: 对比各范式的得分、方差与单步耗时,并试验 RL+minimax 等混合策略
contributions.evaluation: RL 得分高但方差大(PPO std 134.2 vs minimax 23.1),minimax 单步 45.2ms 难实时,启发式 <1ms;混合方法平均分提升 15-20%
contributions.source_quote: These results yield significant insights into algorithm selection trade-offs in constrained gaming environments, with broader implications for AI system design.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We build upon their work while adapting metrics to the unique characteristics of the Snake game.

notes: desk-reject(NeurIPS 2025 模板而非 agents4science 模板,无 AI involvement checklist)。核心结果即 trade-off:RL 高分高方差(PPO 847.3, std 134.2)vs minimax 低分低方差(623.7, std 23.1)vs 启发式快但弱(<1ms, 267.8-445.3)。可信度问题:abstract 写 "847.3 s 12.4" 与正文表格 std 134.2 矛盾;refs [10]-[13](Journal of Game AI、International Journal of Gaming AI 等)疑为虚构期刊/文献;代码链接为 github.com/anonymous 占位;Figure ?? 引用悬空。
